title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization?
description: DSC 209R Project 2: two opposing visualizations of the same World Bank CO₂ data, arguing for and against the claim that the U.S. is making real progress on cutting emissions.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This site: hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript built across the DSC 209R labs, with an automatic navigation menu, dark mode and data-driven project listings.

title: Tile Anomaly Detection
description: Fine-tuned a YOLO model in PyTorch to detect defects in tiles with 86% accuracy, then deployed it on edge devices with TensorRT and DeepStream, cutting latency from 2.3s to 1.1s.

title: Firmographic Intelligence Pipeline
description: An LLM and NLP data pipeline that processes 1,000+ market data entries and news feeds daily. Published in IJSREM (DOI: 10.55041/IJSREM49311).

title: Studybook.AI
description: A RAG study assistant built with LangChain, Hugging Face embeddings and FAISS, with multi-model orchestration (OpenAI, Gemini, Perplexity) and automatic fallback.

title: News Headline Sentiment
description: Scraped 50K+ headlines with Selenium and fine-tuned BERT on them, reaching 89% accuracy; served through a Flask API with a React front end for interactive visualization.

title: Cyclomatic Complexity Analyzer
description: A static analysis tool in C++ that walks Clang’s AST to compute cyclomatic complexity for C#/C++ source files, built with CMake and LLVM.

title: Interactive Visualization (In Progress)
description: DSC 209R Project 3: an interactive D3 visualization built with a team. Coming soon.
